title: Meta launches Muse, its personal AI agent that requires user trust
summary: Meta introduces Muse, a new personal AI agent designed to assist with daily tasks, but its adoption depends on users trusting its privacy and reliability.

title: OpenAI accused of pressuring mathematician to exclude Anthropic co-author from discovery
summary: An OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured an NYU mathematician to remove an Anthropic co-author from a paper on a historic mathematical problem, sparking academic controversy.

title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake in Unreal Engine 5 shows gameplay with fog due to limitations
summary: An unofficial Ocarina of Time remake in Unreal Engine 5 reveals gameplay with modern design and use of fog to hide original hardware limitations.

title: Modders achieve DLSS 5 and Multi Frame Gen on RTX 20, 30, and 40 series cards
summary: Community modifications unlock DLSS 5 and multi-frame generation on RTX GPUs prior to the 50 series, improving performance up to 6 times with hybrid FSR 3.1.

title: Intel plans to raise its PC CPU prices by 10% in October 2026
summary: Intel would increase its desktop processor prices by 10% in October, discontinuing low-margin models, while AMD would follow with increases in summer 2027.

title: Ryzen 9 9950X3D dies after switching to ASUS motherboard, according to reports
summary: Users report that the Ryzen 9 9950X3D processor stops working one hour after switching to an ASUS motherboard, after a year of trouble-free use.

title: Apple preparing foldable iPhone with very high price, according to Mark Gurman leaks
summary: Apple's foldable iPhone would have an extremely high price according to Mark Gurman, and its official unveiling would be imminent.

title: Mistral AI raises 3 billion euros in largest European tech round
summary: French startup Mistral AI closes a record 3 billion euro funding round, establishing itself as European leader in sovereign AI despite trailing US rivals.

title: Hackers steal $320 million in Bitcoin from Liquid Network and promise to return it
summary: Attackers drain 95% of Liquid Network's federated wallet exploiting a flaw in Elements, but claim to be 'good actors' and will return funds after patching the vulnerability.

title: Google AI creates predictive map of 9 billion human DNA mutations
summary: Google's AlphaGenome Atlas maps a high-resolution chart of human genetic variants, enabling prediction of mutation effects on gene regulation.

title: Renault to manufacture 2027 Dacia Spring in Europe to lower cost with subsidies
summary: The next-generation Dacia Spring will be produced in Europe from 2027 instead of China, allowing access to state aid and competing with the BYD Dolphin Surf below 20,000 euros.

title: DaVinci Resolve 21.1 arrives with changes in scripting, editing, and tools
summary: The new version of DaVinci Resolve 21.1 introduces improvements in scripting, editing tools, and workflow for professional post-production.

title: Qwen 3.8 27B benchmarks: 4-bit quantization holds, 1-bit collapses
summary: Tests on RTX 5090 show Qwen 3.8 27B maintains performance at 4-bit but fails at 1-bit, revealing software and inference bottlenecks beyond VRAM.
